statement: For every five-label finite moment system satisfying the frozen hypotheses whose unit directions take exactly three distinct values with multiplicities 3, 1, and 1, there exists an admissible probability vector q supported on at most three labels such that C(q) <= 5E/8.
contribution: A complete proof of the previously isolated 3+1+1 repeated-direction stratum of Assertion 1, using a new exact weighted-triangle edge-distance inequality and the attained singleton-segment reduction. It does not resolve either frozen assertion in full or Conjecture 7.8.
